court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
facts_of_case: The parties got married in 2024 but separated due to differences. The husband initiated divorce proceedings in Sub Court, Sivakasi. The wife seeks transfer of the case to Family Court, Trichy due to difficulties in attending hearings from her current location.

legal_principles.principle: Convenience of the wife should be given a superior consideration than that of husband in matters of transfer.
legal_principles.held: In line with this Parliamentary amendment, this Court and the Supreme Court have consistently held that convenience of wife should be given a superior consideration than that of husband.

legal_principles.principle: The Court should consider the convenience of the wife in matters of transfer.
legal_principles.held: This is an indication that convenience of the wife has to be given precedence by the Court.

outcome.final_order: The court transferred H.M.O.P.No.200 of 2025 from Sub Court, Sivakasi to Family Court, Trichy.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for divorce case
advising on jurisdiction in family law matters
preparing a withdrawal application under section 24 of the Civil Procedure Code
